[1] «Early Orbison | Early Orbison is an album recorded by Roy Orbison on the Monument Records label at their studios in Hendersonville, Tennessee and released in 1964. I Drove All Night | "I Drove All Night" is a song written and composed by American songwriters Billy Steinberg and Tom Kelly and made famous by American singer Cyndi Lauper. The song has been covered by Pinmonkey (2002), and Celine Dion (2003) among others.
